ValidationRule.description: Throws error when the External System or External Case ID is changed and one of the values is null.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( ISCHANGED(External_System__c), ISCHANGED(External_Case_ID__c)), OR( ISNULL(External_Case_ID__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(External_System__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select an External System and acknowledge that External System ID has been provided.
